Exercise normal precaution

in **Dominica**.

Dominica is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * Dominica regularly experiences hurricanes. Review our information on _[Weather and Natural Disasters](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/dominica.html#weather "Weather and Natural Disasters")_ in Dominica.
  * Review our [Travel Guidance for Dominica](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/dominica.html#requirements "Travel Guidance for Dominica") to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.
